task.description: Fix CI failure TENANT_TEMPLATE_SELF_CHECK_FAILED table set mismatch: missing=[] extra=["entity_definitions"]. REQ-226 added the tenant-scoped entity_definitions table (priv/repo/migrations/20260906000001_create_entity_definitions.exs) but never added it to test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's hardcoded @expected_tenant_tables list used by the tenant-template self-check. Added "entity_definitions" to that list in alphabetical order, between "effect_completions" and "event_idempotency".

result.note: One-line test-support-only fix. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean. mix format --check-formatted on the edited file: clean. Forced a genuine fresh tenant_template rebuild by dropping the tenant_template schema (MIX_ENV=test mix run -e 'Ecto.Adapters.SQL.query!(Letflow.Repo, "DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS tenant_template CASCADE", [])') and then running mix test test/letflow/entities/definitions_test.exs, which triggers a byte-fresh template build and self-check -- 16 tests passed, no TENANT_TEMPLATE_SELF_CHECK_FAILED error. Regression: mix test test/support/tenant_template_test.exs -- 7 passed. test/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs does not exist in this repo, so it was skipped. No other files touched.
